---
layout: default
title: Game
---

<div id="game-area" style="color:#ffcc00; font-family:'Times New Roman',serif; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; padding:20px;">
    <div id="status-msg" style="margin-bottom:15px; font-size:1.5rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:3px;">White to Move</div>
    <div id="board-grid" style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(8, 1fr); width:400px; height:400px; border:3px solid #ffcc00; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,204,0,0.4); position:relative;">
        <!-- Squares generated by JS -->
    </div>
    <button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:30px; background:none; border:none; color:#ffcc00; font-family:'Times New Roman',serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1.6rem; letter-spacing:4px; cursor:pointer; text-transform:uppercase;">RELOAD PAGE</button>
    <style>
        .sq { width:50px; height:50px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:35px; cursor:pointer; user-select:none; }
        /* Dark Squares: 45° Crosshatch */
        .dark-sq {
            background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, #ffcc00 0.5px, transparent 0.5px), linear-gradient(-45deg, #ffcc00 0.5px, transparent 0.5px);
            background-size: 6px 6px;
            background-color: rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.05);
        }
        /* Black Pieces: 90° Crosshatch Overlay */
        .p-black {
            position: relative; color: transparent;
            text-shadow: 0 0 0 #ffcc00; /* Outline effect */
        }
        .p-black::after {
            content: attr(data-icon);
            position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0;
            color: #ffcc00;
            background-image: linear-gradient(0deg, #ffcc00 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, #ffcc00 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 3px 3px;
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }
        .p-white { color: #ffcc00; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1px #000); }
        .selected-sq { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) !important; }
    </style>
    <script>
        const boardEl = document.getElementById('board-grid');
        const statusEl = document.getElementById('status-msg');
        let selected = null;
        let turn = 'w';
        // Chess piece icons
        const icons = {
            'r':'♜','n':'♞','b':'♝','q':'♛','k':'♚','p':'♟',
            'R':'♖','N':'♘','B':'♗','Q':'♕','K':'♔','P':'♙'
        };
        let state = [
            ['r','n','b','q','k','b','n','r'],
            ['p','p','p','p','p','p','p','p'],
            ['','','','','','','',''],
            ['','','','','','','',''],
            ['','','','','','','',''],
            ['','','','','','','',''],
            ['P','P','P','P','P','P','P','P'],
            ['R','N','B','Q','K','B','N','R']
        ];
        function draw() {
            boardEl.innerHTML = '';
            for(let r=0; r<8; r++) {
                for(let c=0; c<8; c++) {
                    const sq = document.createElement('div');
                    sq.className = 'sq ' + ((r+c)%2 ? 'dark-sq' : '');
                    if(selected && selected.r === r && selected.c === c) sq.classList.add('selected-sq');
                    const p = state[r][c];
                    if(p) {
                        sq.textContent = icons[p];
                        sq.classList.add(p === p.toUpperCase() ? 'p-white' : 'p-black');
                        sq.setAttribute('data-icon', icons[p]);
                    }
                    sq.onclick = () => {
                        if(selected) {
                            state[r][c] = state[selected.r][selected.c];
                            state[selected.r][selected.c] = '';
                            selected = null;
                            turn = turn === 'w' ? 'b' : 'w';
                            statusEl.innerText = (turn === 'w' ? 'White' : 'Black') + ' to Move';
                        } else if(state[r][c]) {
                            const isWhite = state[r][c] === state[r][c].toUpperCase();
                            if((turn === 'w' && isWhite) || (turn === 'b' && !isWhite)) selected = {r, c};
                        }
                        draw();
                    };
                    boardEl.appendChild(sq);
                }
            }
        }
        draw();
    </script>
</div>
